column1: # Season 3 "Creep Season" as announced on the Paizo Printables Discord #announcements.
# Values below are the LIVE post as re-read 2026-09-28. The post was edited at 09:01 on
# 2026-09-25, 19 minutes after it went up, and the edit changed the Welcome Pack expansion.
# Three of the four disagreements the AoN cross-check flagged on 2026-09-25 were corrections
# Paizo then made themselves, and a tenth model was added that the first version omitted:
#   Earth Elemental - Living Landslide   Large 50mm  ->  Medium 25mm   (AoN: Medium)
#   Water Elemental - Brine Shark        Large 50mm  ->  Medium 25mm   (AoN: Medium)
#   Fortune Dragon                       Large 75mm  ->  Huge   75mm   (AoN: Adult is Huge)
#   Elemental Fire - Living Wildfire     absent      ->  Medium 25mm   (added)
# The expansion is now 10 models, which matches the 2026 roadmap's "Season 3 Welcome Pack
# Expansion - 10 Miniatures, scheduled for October 2nd". The first version listed only 9.
# STILL DISAGREES: Adult Resurrection Dragon is announced Huge 75mm and was not edited, but
# AoN has the Adult Resurrection Dragon as Large (level 12, Monster Core 2); only the Ancient
# is Huge. Base stays 75mm either way, so this affects the size label rather than base stock.
# SUPERSEDED 2026-10-05 for codes and pack: the release is live and reference/incoming.tsv now
# carries the REAL P-numbers (S3P1 = P0101-P0106, Welcome Pack expansion = P0069-P0078).
# The pack_guess column below was WRONG: the expansion is WP6, not WP5. The base_mm and size
# values below were all confirmed correct by the shipped files. variants is the "(3 Miniatures)"
# annotation, equivalent to the sheet's "(3 Models)" and to variant_of() in ledger.py.
# aon_size is a sanity check only - the vendor's stated base governs printing.
